authority: SUB-26 vocalizations; policy features.modal_particles/fillers own Chinese particles and fillers
word_boundary: Foreign ASR surfaces match only (?<![\w])surface(?![\w]) with Unicode word characters; punctuation/space delimit, adjacent kana/Han/Hangul/Latin/digit/underscore do not. No substring conversion in あの人, 아이, uhuru or uh_1.

microcue_filler_exclusion.purpose: References into vocalizations for the existing acoustic-discovery filler skip, not another sound inventory. Coughs and other speaker-context vocalizations still need the ordinary blind-audio review; being nonlexical does not authorize skipping that review or dropping a cue. Policy particles/fillers remain policy-derived.

restatement_prefix_roles.purpose: Compatibility scope for unbounded prefix scoring, not an additional sound inventory; policy references only apply while present in policy, vocalization references only while in vocalizations. Pure-cue classification always uses the whole definition.
